title: 第一卷 第3章 捡到徒弟第一卷 第4章 不做逆徒
slug: 百倍返还我家孽徒全是女帝转世
content_zh:
“还说你没偷！那只狗就是我们仙家居养的！”
壮汉扒拉了两下，见无果，又重重将小乞丐给摔在了地上，不断用脚踹着小乞丐，边踹边骂道。
“狗娘养的的小畜生！小小年纪不学好，居然学着偷东西！”
“你不是想吃吗？老子就是踩烂了喂鸡喂狗也不给你吃！！”
看着小乞丐蜷缩在一起不断发抖的身子，壮汉似乎还不解气。
他又不断的用脚猛踩大白菜。恶狠狠的发泄完之后，他总算舒服了。
随即，仙家居掌柜蔡只因又怒斥道。
“你给老子滚，要是再被我发现你偷东西，非得见你一次打你一次！”
见到这一幕，周围人似乎都见怪不怪了。
随着身上不断传来剧烈的疼痛，让小乞丐眼泪豆大豆大的流下，但却一声没吭。
不知不觉间，她仿佛失去了知觉，气息微弱无比，但双手依旧死死的抓住那颗大白菜，不愿松手。
“我…”
“我要死了吗？”
“可我还不想死，我还没有为爹娘报仇……真的好不甘心啊！”
小乞丐身子剧烈颤抖，看上去是那么惹人心疼。
恍惚间，她仿佛看到了儿时的苏家，看到了娘亲的怀抱，看到了爹爹那慈祥的笑容。
“爹，娘……”
“雨姝…雨姝不能为你们报仇了，你们会怪罪雨姝吗……”
意识渐渐沉下，柳雨姝的身子越发沉重。
不知不觉间，她两腿一软，彻底昏死了过去。

见到这一幕，围观的人群也是不忍心的转过头去。
却没有一个人敢上前。
毕竟，在这个残酷的修仙界里，他们自身都难保，那还有精力去管别人的死活？
最多也就等到柳雨姝死后，找个地方挖个坑把她埋了。
“嘿，没想到这么不经揍，才踹几脚就死了。”
蔡只因扭了扭脖子，似乎还没过瘾。
突然间，他看向了柳雨姝那脏兮兮的小脸蛋，忍不住咽了咽口水。
“啧啧，没想到这个小乞丐还是个女娃子……”
说着，他便弯腰将罪恶的双手伸向了柳雨姝。
“住手！！”
就在所有人注视着即将发生了一幕，一道声音突然在远处传来。
与此同时，一道凌然的气息直接冲向了他。
content_en:
"And you said you didn't steal it! That dog is raised by our fairy family!"
The strong man pulled twice, but saw no result, and threw the little beggar to the ground. He kept kicking the little beggar with his feet, and cursed while kicking him.
"You little son of a bitch! You didn't learn well at a young age, but you actually learned to steal!"
"Don't you want to eat? Even if I trample it to pieces and feed it to chickens and dogs, I won't give it to you!!"
Seeing the little beggar huddled together and shaking, the strong man seemed to be still angry.
He kept stepping on the cabbage with his feet. After venting his anger, he finally felt comfortable.
Immediately, Cai Zhiyin, the shopkeeper of Xianjia, reprimanded again.
"Get out of here, if I catch you stealing again, I will beat you every time I see you!"
Seeing this scene, everyone around seemed to be surprised.
As severe pain continued to come from his body, the little beggar shed tears, but he did not say a word.
Unknowingly, she seemed to have lost consciousness, her breath was extremely weak, but she still grabbed the cabbage with both hands and refused to let go.
"I..."
"Am I going to die?"
"But I don't want to die yet. I haven't avenged my parents yet... I'm really unwilling to accept it!"
The little beggar was shaking violently and looked so distressing.
In a daze, she seemed to see the Su family of her childhood, her mother's arms, and her father's kind smile.
"Dad, mother..."
"Yushu... Yushu can't avenge you anymore, will you blame Yushu..."
As her consciousness gradually sank, Liu Yushu's body became heavier and heavier.
Unconsciously, her legs went weak and she passed out completely.
Seeing this scene, the onlookers couldn't bear to turn their heads.
But no one dared to step forward.
After all, in this cruel world of cultivating immortals, they can't protect themselves, so how can they still have the energy to care about the life and death of others?
The most they can do is wait until Liu Yushu dies and find a place to dig a hole and bury her.
"Hey, I didn't expect that he would die after just a few kicks without being beaten."
Cai just twisted his neck, as if he hadn't had enough yet.
Suddenly, he looked at Liu Yushu's dirty little face and couldn't help but swallow.
"Tsk, tsk, I didn't expect this little beggar to be a girl..."
With that said, he bent down and stretched out his sinful hands towards Liu Yushu.
"Stop!!"
Just as everyone was watching the scene that was about to happen, a voice suddenly came from the distance.
At the same time, a Ling Ran aura rushed directly towards him.
